name: datarust-site
description: Static documentation and blog site for datarust

scripts.build:worker: cargo rustc --release -p datarust-mcp --lib --crate-type cdylib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --target-dir target/worker --locked
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run build:worker && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
